title: Awesome flesh-burning death lamp.   (Germicidal UV)
summary: BigClive tears down and tests a germicidal UVC lamp from eBay that floods a room with narrow-band ultraviolet and ozone. He warns of the eye and skin hazards.
why: HN points to BigClive as a source for how cheap UVC lamps actually work and what they emit.

quote.text: BigClive has some interesting videos on these kinds of lights
